# Feature: Synthesis Engine (deterministic + LLM)

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-014
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_v2.md` (row FEAT-014; §4 "Synthesis" concept; §6 sanitizer + no-uncited-claims rules; §7 "Pipeline is a composable stage chain" and "Synthesizer is a Strategy"; §9 Golden-Brief suite + citation-faithfulness property test; §10 synthesis events)

Turn N extracted articles into **one** synthesized `Brief` — the cross-source reasoning the MVP never had. A new **Synthesize** stage joins the pipeline (`Search → Fetch → Extract → Synthesize → Render`) as a peer of the existing pluggable stages, behind a single `Synthesizer` strategy interface with two implementations:

- **`DeterministicSynthesizer`** — the testable backbone and the `--no-llm` answer. Multi-doc near-duplicate clustering, key-point + entity/number extraction, comparison-facet building, citation mapping. No LLM, no network, fully golden-testable.
- **`LlmSynthesizer`** — the default for `public`-scope content. Sends **sanitized** extracted text to the model, receives Markdown with inline `[n]` citations, parses and validates it back into the `Brief` schema, and falls back to the deterministic strategy on any failure (`metadata.deterministic_fallback_used: true`).

A **citation-faithfulness validator** runs after _both_ strategies and enforces the v2 structural guarantee: every claim maps to a provided source span or gets flagged/stripped into `notices`, with the verdict recorded in `metadata.citation_verdict`.

**Refactor context:** this replaces per-source summarization (`RuleBasedSummarizer` in `packages/core/src/extraction/summarizer.ts` and the gated `createLlmSummarizer()` in `llm-summarizer.ts`) with cross-source synthesis. Those modules are **deleted** in the FEAT-015 cutover; this feature builds the replacement alongside them (strangler-fig). `AskPipeline` keeps producing `AskCard`s untouched until FEAT-015 rewires it.

## 2. Data Model (Granular)

> No `.spec-lite/data_model.md` exists — designed here. All types are in-memory TS interfaces in `packages/core/src/synthesis/types.ts` except where noted; the output document is FEAT-013's protocol `Brief`.

### Entities & Attributes

- **SynthesisInput**:
  - `query` (string) — the user's normalized question/topic.
  - `docs` (readonly SynthesisDoc[]) — extracted articles, order = search rank.
  - `failures` (readonly SourceFailure[]) — per-source fetch/extract failures to surface as `notices` (honesty rule).
- **SynthesisDoc** (adapts existing `ExtractedDoc` from `packages/core/src/extraction/types.ts`):
  - `url`, `finalUrl` (string | null), `host`, `title` (string | null), `fetchedAt` (ISO), `publishedAt` (ISO | null),
  - `text` (string) — extracted plain text (Readability output), `excerpt` (string | null).
- **SynthesisOptions**:
  - `strategy` (`'auto' | 'deterministic' | 'llm'`) — `auto` = LLM for `public` scope unless `--no-llm`; anything else deterministic.
  - `detail` (`'overview' | 'standard' | 'full'`), `length` (`'short' | 'medium' | 'long'`) — synthesis depth budgets (how many sections/findings to emit).
  - `scope` (`'public' | 'read-only-data' | 'authenticated'`) — drives the sanitizer profile.
  - `taskId`, `runId` (string), `searchProvider` (string | null) — provenance for `metadata`.
- **SynthesisOutcome**:
  - `brief` (Brief) — schema-valid, citation-validated document.
  - `verdict` (CitationVerdict) — `{ claimsChecked, flagged, stripped }` (also stamped into `brief.metadata.citation_verdict`).
  - `strategyUsed` (`'deterministic' | 'llm'`), `fallbackUsed` (boolean).
- **SourceCluster** (internal to deterministic synth):
  - `representative` (doc index), `members` (int[]), `similarity` (number 0–1) — near-duplicate groups; one citation number per cluster representative, members recorded as `final_url` aliases.
- **ExtractedClaim** (internal):
  - `text` (string), `docIndexes` (int[]), `kind` (`'fact' | 'number' | 'entity' | 'quote'`), `salience` (number) — ranked to become `key_findings`.

### Relationships

- SynthesisInput 1:1 SynthesisOutcome; SynthesisOutcome 1:1 Brief (plan §4: Task → Synthesis → Brief is 1:1:1).
- SynthesisDoc N:1 SourceCluster; SourceCluster 1:1 Brief `Source` entry (`n` assigned by cluster order: rank of representative).
- ExtractedClaim N:M SynthesisDoc via `docIndexes` → becomes `KeyFinding.citations`.

### Indexes & Constraints

- Source numbering is deterministic: clusters sorted by best member's search rank → `n = 1..N`. Same input always yields the same Brief on the deterministic path (golden-testability invariant).
- Similarity threshold for clustering: cosine ≥ 0.85 on TF-IDF vectors (tunable constant, documented).
- LLM output is untrusted input: parsed via `validateBrief` boundary (Zod), max 2 bounded re-prompts on validation failure (memory §Error Handling), then deterministic fallback.

## 4. Dependencies

- **FEAT-013** (Brief schema, `validateBrief`, exported test arbitraries) — hard.
- Existing: extraction types (`ExtractedDoc`), sanitizer chokepoint (`packages/core/src/sanitizer`), `LLMClient` interface + `Sanitized<T>` brand (`packages/agent`, FEAT-011), `Result` helpers.
- **Layering note**: `core` must not import `agent` (only `agent → core` is forbidden by compiler today, but keep the boundary clean per plan §6). `LlmSynthesizer` therefore depends on a minimal injected `SynthesisLlm` port interface declared in `synthesis/types.ts`; `apps/cli` adapts the real `LLMClient` to it at wiring time (same DI pattern as `createLlmSummarizer()` uses today).

### TASK-006: Citation-faithfulness validator

- [ ] **Implementation**: `citation-validator.ts` — deterministic post-pass over any Brief + its `SynthesisInput`: (1) structural — every `[n]` in `overview`/`body_md`/finding text and every `citations[]` entry resolves to a source (schema already refuses dangling arrays; this also scans inline Markdown text); (2) anchoring (LLM path only) — for each cited claim, fuzzy-match claim content words against the cited source's sanitized text; below-threshold claims get `flagged` (kept, noticed) at `standard` strictness or `stripped` (removed, noticed) for numeric claims that fail anchoring; (3) uncited non-editorial sentences in LLM output → flagged. Emits `CitationVerdict`, stamps `metadata.citation_verdict`, appends `uncited_claim_*` notices. Deterministic-path Briefs must always pass with zero flags (claims carry their evidence by construction).
- [ ] **Unit Tests**: fabricated claim citing a source that never mentions it → flagged; fabricated _price_ citing a source without that number → stripped + notice; deterministic Brief → zero flags (property over generated corpora, reusing FEAT-013's `validBriefArb` + corpus arbitraries); inline `[n]` beyond source count → flagged even though arrays validate.
- [ ] **Documentation Update**: `docs/` architecture note (or plan-referenced doc section) describing the no-uncited-claims enforcement chain: schema refinement → validator → notices.
- **Verify**: the plan §9 property test passes 500+ runs: no claim references a missing source index; every LLM-path sentence is cited or editorial-marked. `@no-llm`.

## 6. Cross-Cutting Concerns

- **Auth**: N/A — public-content synthesis in this feature; `read-only-data`/`authenticated` scopes reuse existing sanitizer profiles when `run` results adopt Briefs (FEAT-015+).
- **Error Handling**: all stages return `Result<T, E>`; LLM failures degrade to deterministic fallback (never a dead end — the agent-optional invariant); per-source failures become `notices`, never silent drops (honesty rule, plan §1 invariant 3).
- **Logging**: `synthesis_completed` event per plan §10 (strategy, source counts, coverage, citation verdict) into `events.jsonl`; LLM calls audited via the existing `wrapWithAudit` → `agent.jsonl` (tokens, cost). Never log doc text at info level; sanitized-payload hashes at debug only.
- **Security**: `LlmSynthesizer` is a new LLM call site — sanitize-before-send enforced by code path _and_ by the extended CI static check; the citation validator is the enforcement mechanism for the new no-uncited-claims structural guarantee (plan §6).
